errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a linear scale. The ticks are at 1, 2, 4, and 8, which are not at equal numerical intervals.
„Errors (COPA)“ is the title of the chart, not the label for the Y-axis. The Y-axis is not labeled.
The Y-axis has labeled ticks at intervals of 0.3 (0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9), not 0.1.
The value for k=1 is approximately 0.68 or 0.7, not 0.64. The reported value is visibly too low and appears to be outside the range of the error bar.
The description fails to mention that the circular markers are green, which is a prominent visual feature.

The x-axis does not have steps of 1. The tick marks are at 1, 2, 4, and 8.
The y-axis is not labeled. "Errors (COPA)" is the title of the chart.
